steps.title: Create a base rectangle
steps.body: Draw a rectangular building footprint. This is a massing exercise, not a full architecture tool workflow.

steps.title: Push the wall mass
steps.body: Use Push/Pull to extrude the footprint into a low box.

steps.title: Sketch a roof guide
steps.body: Use Line or Construction Line to sketch a ridge guide. Exact ridge automation is pending command and pointer validation.

success.prompt: A roof guide line or draft is visible.

steps.title: Inspect the massing
steps.body: Orbit around the result and confirm the model reads as a simple house form.

success.prompt: The house massing is readable from perspective view.
